run_get_news: run get_news to fetch market news and sentiment data for a specific ticker symbol within a date range
run_get_global_news: run get_global_news to fetch broad market news and sentiment without ticker filtering

summarize_get_global_news: summarize the get_global_news function that retrieves global financial market news over a lookback period
